description: Original descriptive GenerateDoc design, not an executable cloud-flow export. Configure actions, connections, response fields, run-after failure branches, file layout, and destination in the builder's own development environment.

configuration.availability: Only when referenced by topics or agents
configuration.caller: Create Worksheet topic after explicit approval of the exact current payload

sample_fixtures.source_contract: Each .txt file is the complete original fictional guide.
sample_fixtures.expected_contract: Each .json file is a flat expected worksheet with exactly 17 string fields, not an object containing a sample or worksheet wrapper.
sample_fixtures.usage: For development document-fidelity checks, review the expected worksheet before using its serialized object as ApprovedJSON. Compare the generated document against those exact approved values. Do not treat fixture replay as a successful platform run or return a fixture after a flow failure.

trigger.label: When an agent calls the flow

ApprovalConfirmed.meaning: True only after deliberate reviewer confirmation

ApprovedRevision.meaning: Topic-owned integer revision that was approved

security_and_delivery.destination: A newly created sample output location in the builder's own development tenant; no existing organizational content is required.
security_and_delivery.permissions: Use only an approved connection with the minimum required access. Test using the intended reviewer's identity; the connection owner's access is not proof the reviewer can open the file.
security_and_delivery.file_naming: Generate a collision-resistant file name with the platform, not the model. Never accept a file path or destination from worksheet text.
security_and_delivery.link_policy: Prefer an actual file web URL that uses existing access. If a sharing link is necessary, separately configure and review its permissions. Anonymous sharing is not the default.
security_and_delivery.email: Not configured. Returning a document URL does not mean an email was sent.
security_and_delivery.retry_policy: Do not blindly retry file creation. After a timeout or uncertain action result, inspect the actual run and destination before any new creation attempt. If a file exists, resume link resolution for that file instead.
security_and_delivery.logging: Use the environment's approved operational run history and access controls. Review retention and secure-input/output settings before using any non-fictional data. Do not store approval or source-ledger metadata in the worksheet.

actions.label: Condition
requirements: ApprovalConfirmed must be true.
DraftRevision and ApprovedRevision must be positive integers and equal.
The topic must already have checked that ApprovedJSON equals CurrentJSON; these inputs alone cannot prove that comparison.
A review flag is not authentication. Restrict invocation to the configured topic and permitted users.
actions.on_failure: Respond with Status failed, empty DocumentURL, and an approval error. Do not call the prompt or create a file.

actions.label: Parse JSON
requirements: Use the worksheet schema's required keys, string property types, additionalProperties false, and supported per-field constraints in the Parse JSON schema. Enforce any unsupported schema constraint with a separate explicit guard rather than silently dropping it.
Require a single worksheet object with exactly 17 keys. Do not use a sample-derived permissive schema without inspecting it.
Do not repair or re-extract an approved payload inside this flow. A schema failure requires return to review.
actions.on_failure: Respond with Status failed and a schema error before any side effect.

actions.label: Run a prompt
requirements: Exactly 17 named Text inputs, mapped one to one from ParsedWorksheet; no AI-filled action inputs.
Upload the freshly authored unfilled layout with all 17 scalar placeholders. An empty document is not a layout.
Choose the actual Document Output Content Bytes dynamic output. Do not assume an undocumented nested response path.
The prompt must preserve supplied text. Model-based formatting is not a guarantee of exact fidelity; compare a generated Word file during acceptance.
actions.on_failure: Respond with Status failed and a document-generation error; no fake file URL.

actions.label: Condition
requirements: Require a successful prompt action and a nonempty actual document payload.

Bind the documented Document Output Content Bytes output to file content. If the selected action exposes base64 text instead of a typed file value, inspect that run's schema and decode once; never double-decode.
A nonempty payload only proves bytes were returned, not that the worksheet text is correct.
actions.on_failure: Respond with Status failed and an empty-document error. Do not create a placeholder file.

actions.label: Create file
actions.connector: SharePoint, using the builder's separately configured storage connection

bindings.content: Actual Document Output Content Bytes from run_generate_prompt

requirements: Use a newly created sample destination. Do not overwrite an existing file.
Capture the real created-file reference from this action's result.
Do not declare success before this action has succeeded.
actions.on_failure: Respond with Status failed for a known failure, or unknown if creation may have occurred. Return no invented URL.

actions.label: Configured file URL lookup; optional sharing-link action only after permission review
requirements: Resolve a real web URL for the exact created-file reference using the selected connector's supported outputs/actions.
Do not build a URL by concatenating a guessed site path and worksheet title.
Keep existing access unless the builder deliberately configures a different approved sharing policy.
Do not treat the connection owner's ability to open a file as proof of recipient access.
actions.on_failure: Respond with Status created_link_unavailable, the actual ArtifactReference, and an empty DocumentURL. A file exists, but no downloadable link is confirmed.

actions.label: Respond to the agent
requirements: Use identical output names and types on every explicit response branch.
Set Asynchronous response to Off.
Complete document creation and link resolution before returning Status succeeded.
Do not put promised creation or delivery after the response action.

fields.DocumentURL: Actual verified connector-returned file web URL on success; otherwise empty string
fields.ArtifactReference: Actual created-file reference when known; otherwise empty string
fields.UserMessage: Plain-language true outcome with no source text, raw connector diagnostics, or fabricated delivery claim

response_contract.success_gate: Only return succeeded when a nonempty document was stored successfully and its real URL was resolved. The reviewer must still inspect content and access.

failure_examples.failed: The document could not be created. Your worksheet draft is unchanged.
failure_examples.created_link_unavailable: The file was created, but its link could not be resolved. Your draft is unchanged; an operator should recover the existing file.
failure_examples.unknown: The request did not finish with a confirmed result. Your draft is unchanged. Check the run and destination before creating another file.

timeouts_and_correction.behavior: Design and measure the synchronous path within the documented limit. A connector or agent timeout can prevent a structured response; the topic must handle that error as an unknown outcome.
timeouts_and_correction.schema_correction: No schema-correction model call in GenerateDoc. The topic owns its bounded correction before approval.
timeouts_and_correction.generation_retry: No automatic whole-flow retry. Keep the approved draft and require deliberate, safe recovery from the actual recorded outcome.
